title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Fresh Mint 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Fresh Mint delivers a crisp and cooling sensation with every puff. The clean, herbal notes of fresh Mint create a subtly sweet and refreshing flavour, offering a perfectly balanced vape that is both smooth and soothing, and bright and uplifting in equal measure. Part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Fresh Mint is designed to replicate the bold, pure flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures lasting freshness while maintaining a smooth and satisfying vape experience. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid provides an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation offers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for use with pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their commitment to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a trusted choice for vapers.
